title: The court rejects Elon’s latest attempt to slow OpenAI down
reason: Major regulatory verdict rejecting Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI is a significant legal and corporate development.

sources.summary: We welcome the court’s March 4, 2025, decision rejecting Elon Musk’s latest attempt to slow down OpenAI for his personal benefit.
We are dedicated to the OpenAI mission and have pursued it every step of the way.
